events.title: Steam Next Fest: Play the Crownsink Demo - Update 0.3.0
events.summary: Dear Wardens,Crownsink is part of Steam Next Fest, and we are very happy to be here.Crownsink is a top-down co-op roguelite for one to four players. Your weapons fire themselves, so you decide where to stand, when to dodge, and what to build. The free demo is the whole first world: six floors, five heroes and the Skeleton King at the bottom. events.title: The Crownsink Demo Is Out + Roadmap to 1.0
events.summary: Dear Wardens,the first world of Crownsink is open, and it costs nothing to go down. The demo is live on Steam right now. What's in the demo:The whole first world. Six floors of the Dungeon, each one freshly generated, with the Skeleton King on the sixth.Five heroes. Knight, Ranger, Mage, Rogue and Barbarian, with sword, bow, wand, throwing daggers and axe. events.title: The Crownsink Demo is Coming
events.summary: Dear Wardens,On 28th September 2026, the Crownsink Demo will be available to everyone!This demo is the next step in development and gives you a closer look at what Crownsink is becoming. We’ve been working on the game, listening to your feedback, and pushing it further — and now it’s time to let you back in. And there’s more: Crownsink will be part of Steam Next Fest this October.So if you’re ready to descend into the pit, 28th September 2026 is your first chance to get your hands on the demo —
